subject: Map/Reduce example job from the installation manual fails

messages.author: f6f23a058361dee9
messages.subject: Map/Reduce example job from the installation manual fails
parts:
RHIPE installs but fails to complete the example Map/Reduce job from
the installation manual. The job appears to run on the Hadoop
cluster but returns this exception:

> ## Read the results
> res <- rhread('/tmp/test')
Error in if (sz1 <= 0) { : argument is of length zero

We're running under CentOS 5.6 and we tried the RHIPE 0.65.4
distribution as well as the GIT repository. We also tried Google
Protocol Buffers 2.3.0 and 2.4.1. Before we can feel confident that
the RHIPE installation is correct, we need to get the example Map/
Reduce script working.

Thanks,

Chris

Okay, so the presence of a SUCCESS file is messing things up.
Use rhread("/tmp/test/p*")

I'll release a bug fix version that will fix this (right now it skips _logs but i'll make it user configurable).
tomorrow.

It also includes other bugs fixes too.

But the version after that is the major version that ought to improve the reducer a lot in the case of many keys with small set of values.
